# New Wave och Embracer rapporterar – förvaltaren om rapportperioden

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-11-11  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Kavaljer fund manager Jesper von Koch says index records hide how narrow the rally is, since a few AI-infrastructure names (Atlas Copco, ABB) and Saab drive it while most small caps have lagged for two years. He sees Q3 as a turning point: per Pinpoint SMS data, more Stockholm companies beat earnings estimates than missed for the first time since Q1 2023. He backs quality mid-caps like New Wave, Proact and Nederman for a re-rating and avoids Embracer and the gaming sector. Guest David Bianco of Deutsche Asset Management (DWS) is constructive on equities and bonds and favours US financials, healthcare and hyperscalers.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 NEWA-B — New Wave | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

One of Kavaljer's largest holdings. Q3 EBIT beat estimates with a margin above 13% despite one-off investment costs.

#### Reasoning

Guest von Koch (fund manager, holder) sees large upside because the market doubts a return to 15-17% EBIT margins, which the company has reached before. Profitability beat estimates even though organic growth was 3% (1pp miss), while one-off costs for ERP roll-outs, Dallas logistics, automation and Poland still weigh. Volumes have not recovered yet, so operating leverage is ahead.

#### Sell Triggers

- if EBIT margin fails to recover toward 15-17%
- if volumes don't recover
- if investment costs persist without margin uplift

> *"New Wave är ett av våra största innehav i Kavalikolit i fokus. Anledningen är att vi tycker att det finns en väldigt stor uppsida."*

---

### 🟢 PACT — Proact | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Kavaljer holding. Targets to double adjusted EPS by 2030. Von Koch says it trades at P/E 7 on target EPS and P/E 13 on 2026 profit, which he thinks is too low.

#### Reasoning

Guest von Koch (holder) calls the new targets reasonable: doubling EPS to at least SEK 20 by 2030 at a price around SEK 140 would give ~20% annual return if met, and he thinks it deserves P/E 15. The rolling 8.5% EBITA margin vs the >8% target suggests current margins are sustainable. He expects only a neutral short-term reaction to the CMD.

#### Sell Triggers

- if EPS growth stalls versus 2030 doubling target
- if margin falls below 8%
- if estimates of declining profit materialize

> *"Proact borde vara ett P15-bolag, tycker jag."*

---

### 🟢 NMAN — Nederman | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Quality mid-cap on a low P/E based on recession-level profits. Orders turned up in Q2, and von Koch expects strong profit growth from Q4 through 2027.

#### Reasoning

Guest von Koch (Lapour holding) cites a 20-year record of ~9% annual growth and improving margins, and a historical median P/E of ~19 vs P/E 14 on next year. Q2 order growth should turn into revenue with a two-quarter lag, so he expects strong profit growth from Q4 and likely through 2027, with no peak earnings priced in.

#### Sell Triggers

- if order intake growth reverses
- if Q4 earnings growth fails to materialize
- if rate hikes stall the industrial recovery

> *"Så därför tycker jag att Nederman är väldigt intressant."*

---

### ⛔ EMBRAC-B — Embracer | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Von Koch stays away from gaming, comparing it to oil exploration, and has kept Embracer on his 'graveyard pile' since the pandemic.

#### Reasoning

Guest von Koch is skeptical of the video game industry structurally because results depend on hoping for hits. This is despite Q3 growth beating consensus and the stock being up 60% YTD; it reversed to -4% intraday. The view is sector-based, not a detailed analysis of the report.

> *"dataspelsbranschen, det är ändå lite som oljeprospektering, att man hoppas på att det ska bli en hit, men man vet inte riktigt. Så jag håller mig borta från det."*

---

### 🟡 NVDA — Nvidia | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Bianco (DWS CIO) expects strong chipmaker growth over the next 1-2 years but prefers hyperscalers and flags US-China tension.

#### Reasoning

Guest David Bianco expects robust semiconductor growth because hyperscaler capex continues, and he still backs Jensen Huang as leader. He notes some valuations depend on strong growth, supply-chain reliance on Taiwan, and doubts about the pace of capex. He prefers hyperscalers and connectivity equipment.

#### Sell Triggers

- if data center capex slows sharply
- if US-China tensions disrupt supply chain
- if order outlook weakens in report

---

### 🟢 GOOGL — Alphabet | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Bianco prefers the hyperscalers: higher quality, more reasonable valuation, strong balance sheets.

#### Reasoning

Guest Bianco prefers the three biggest hyperscalers over neoclouds like CoreWeave. He cites the best long-term story, more reasonable valuations, stronger balance sheets and a benign cost of capital, and says they will keep spending.

#### Sell Triggers

- if cost of capital rises materially
- if AI capex returns disappoint

---

### 🟢 MSFT — Microsoft | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

One of the three hyperscalers Bianco prefers.

#### Reasoning

Guest Bianco sees Microsoft as one of the hyperscalers with a better competitive position, strong cash flow and a benign cost of capital, and expects it to keep building data centers.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI capex returns disappoint

---

### 🟢 AMZN — Amazon | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

One of the three hyperscalers Bianco prefers.

#### Reasoning

Guest Bianco names Amazon among the key hyperscalers that build the best data centers and have the cash flow to keep spending.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI capex returns disappoint
